% use option [draft] for initial submission
%            [final] for the prepublication
%% `final` is omitted when `linenumbers` is requested alone: class options execute
%% in declaration order, and both draft and final overwrite the line-number flag.
%% See docs/template-internals.md "Class options".
\documentclass[[-options.journal-],nameyear[# if options.draft #],draft[# elif options.linenumbers #][# else #],final[# endif #][# if options.supplement #],supplement[# endif #][# if options.seceqn #],seceqn[# endif #][# if options.linenumbers #],linenumbers[# endif #][# if doc.open_access #],openaccess[# endif #]]{econsocart}
%

%% Packages MyST's LaTeX renderer does not auto-inject and econsocart does not
%% provide, loaded so raw-LaTeX content using them compiles. cleveref loads later
%% (it must follow hyperref). Full list and exclusions: README "LaTeX packages".
\usepackage{algpseudocode}

%% Author-supplied packages via the `extra_packages` export option, e.g.
%%   extra_packages: tikz,pgfplots
%% See README "LaTeX packages" for the three that must not be listed.
[# if options.extra_packages #]
\usepackage{[-options.extra_packages-]}
[# endif #]

%% The imports placeholder injects the packages MyST needs for native content,
%% except those declared in template.yml `packages:`. Declaring a package that
%% nothing actually loads suppresses the injection and breaks the build.
[-IMPORTS-]

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Theorem numbering                        %%
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% MyST generates section-based counters (Theorem 1.1); the journals number
%% globally. \counterwithout is a LaTeX2e kernel command (2023-06-01 or newer),
%% not etoolbox. See docs/template-internals.md "Theorem counters".
\makeatletter
\@ifundefined{c@theorem}{}{%
  \counterwithout{theorem}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@definition}{}{%
  \counterwithout{definition}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@example}{}{%
  \counterwithout{example}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@remark}{}{%
  \counterwithout{remark}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@axiom}{}{%
  \counterwithout{axiom}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@proposition}{}{%
  \counterwithout{proposition}{section}}
%% corollary is the exception: MyST parents it to theorem, not section, so detach
%% it from theorem. Sweeping it with {section} renumbers every corollary to 1.
%% See docs/template-internals.md "Theorem counters".
\@ifundefined{c@corollary}{}{%
  \counterwithout{corollary}{theorem}}
\@ifundefined{c@conjecture}{}{%
  \counterwithout{conjecture}{section}}
\@ifundefined{c@observation}{}{%
  \counterwithout{observation}{section}}

\makeatother

%% Defined for the assumption and algorithm prf kinds. algorithm is a theorem, not
%% the float package. Released myst-to-tex DROPS both from the .tex (upstream
%% issue 3030). See README "Algorithms" and docs/template-internals.md.
\theoremstyle{plain}
\newtheorem{assumption}{Assumption}
\newtheorem{algorithm}{Algorithm}

%% cleveref must load after amsmath, amsthm, hyperref, and the theorem
%% definitions above, so it is loaded here at the end of the preamble.
\usepackage{cleveref}

%% MyST joins multi-article exports with \include, whose implicit
%% \clearpage would start every section on a new page; a journal
%% article has no chapter breaks, so read those files with \input.
\let\include\input

%% Preprint strips the journal IDENTIFICATION while keeping the journal's own
%% layout, class option and bibliography style. Orthogonal to `journal`.
%% See README "Preprint mode".
[# if options.preprint #]
\makeatletter
%% Empty the journal name via \form@runauthors, never by rewriting \markboth, and
%% keep the \hfill in \copyright@text. Dropping either collides the draft
%% line-number boxes with the text. See docs/template-internals.md.
\def\form@runauthors{\gdef\@runjournal{}}
\def\copyright@text{\hfill}
\makeatother
[# endif #]

\endlocaldefs

\begin{document}

\begin{frontmatter}

%% `default('')` precedes `string`, which calls .toString() and THROWS on an
%% absent key. A page inheriting short_title from the project has none of its own,
%% so the export aborted while myst still exited 0 and kept the stale PDF.
[# macro esc(s) #][-s|default('')|string|replace('\\','\\textbackslash{}')|replace('&','\\&')|replace('%','\\%')|replace('#','\\#')|replace('_','\\_')|replace('~','\\textasciitilde{}')|replace('^','\\textasciicircum{}')-][# endmacro #]
[# macro escmath(s) #][-s|default('')|string|replace('&','\\&')|replace('%','\\%')|replace('#','\\#')-][# endmacro #]
%% The running head falls back to the title. An absent short_title used to render
%% \runtitle{}, which printed a BLANK running head on every odd page rather than
%% failing; a too-long head is visibly wrong, an empty one is not.
\title{[-escmath(doc.title)-]}
\runtitle{[-escmath(doc.short_title or doc.title)-]}

\begin{aug}
% use \particle for den|der|de|van|von (only lc!)
% [add1]{\fnms{}~\snm{}\ead[label=e?]{}}
%
%% e-mail is mandatory for each author
%
%%% initials in fnms (if any) with spaces
%
[# for author in doc.authors #]
%% The bracket group is emitted only for authors that have affiliations, and the
%% full name is the LAST resort of the SURNAME chain, never a given-name fallback
%% (that rendered a mononym as "Aristotle Aristotle"). See docs/template-internals.md.
\author[# if author.affiliations #][
[#- for affiliation in author.affiliations -#]
[#- if affiliation is string -#]
[-affiliation-]
[#- else -#]
[-affiliation.id|default(affiliation)-]
[#- endif -#]
[#- if not loop.last -#],[#- endif -#]
[#- endfor -#]][# endif #]{
[#- if author.nameParsed.given is defined -#]
\fnms{[-esc(author.nameParsed.given|trim)-]}~
[#- elif author.name.given is defined -#]
\fnms{[-esc(author.name.given|trim)-]}~
[#- elif author.given is defined -#]
\fnms{[-esc(author.given|trim)-]}~
[#- endif -#]
\snm{
[#- if author.nameParsed.family is defined -#]
[-esc(author.nameParsed.family|trim)-]
[#- elif author.name.surname is defined -#]
[-esc(author.name.surname|trim)-]
[#- elif author.surname is defined -#]
[-esc(author.surname|trim)-]
[#- elif author.family is defined -#]
[-esc(author.family|trim)-]
[#- else -#]
[-esc(author.name|trim)-]
[#- endif -#]}[# if author.email #]\ead[label=e[-loop.index-]]{[-author.email-]}[# endif #]}
[# endfor #]
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Addresses                                %%
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% \orgdiv and its comma are emitted only for affiliations carrying a department;
%% a bare `name:` affiliation otherwise prints a stray comma.
%% See docs/template-internals.md "Authors and addresses".
[# for affiliation in doc.affiliations #]
\address[[-affiliation.id-]]{%
[# if affiliation.department|default('')|trim #]
\orgdiv{[-esc(affiliation.department|trim)-]},
[# endif #]
\orgname{[-esc(affiliation.institution|default(affiliation.name)|default('')|trim)-]}}

[# endfor #]
%% Fallback address for authors with no affiliations: the class substitutes the
%% literal label `default` rather than skipping the lookup. Inert when unused.
%% See docs/template-internals.md "Authors and addresses".
\address[default]{}

\end{aug}

[# if not options.supplement #]
%% Put support info here
[# if parts.acknowledgement #]
\begin{funding}
[-parts.acknowledgement-]
\end{funding}
[# endif #]
%
%% Suppressed in preprint mode: the class placeholder asserts a co-editor handled
%% the manuscript, which is the submission signal `preprint` exists to strip.
%% See README "Template Options".
[# if not options.preprint #]
\coeditor{\fnm{[Name} \snm{Surname}; will be inserted later]}
[# endif #]
[# endif #]

[# if parts.abstract #]
\begin{abstract}
[-parts.abstract-]
\end{abstract}
[# endif #]

[# if not options.supplement #]
%% The guard wraps \begin{keyword}, not just the \kwd list: the class emits its
%% "Keywords." label when the ENVIRONMENT opens, so an empty one printed a bare
%% label. Same trap as the JEL block below, which was fixed first.
[# if doc.keywords #]
\begin{keyword}
[# for kw in doc.keywords #]
\kwd{[-esc(kw|trim)-]}
[# endfor #]
\end{keyword}
[# endif #]

%% Omit the block when there are no codes: the class prints its "JEL
%% CLASSIFICATION" label regardless of content. Also suppressed under ecta, with
%% a trace left in the .tex. See docs/template-internals.md "JEL codes".
[# if doc.tags #]
[# if options.journal == "ecta" #]
%% JEL codes present in the document frontmatter were omitted here: Econometrica
%% house style carries no JEL classification block. They still appear in the qe
%% and te exports of this same source.
[# else #]
\begin{keyword}[class=JEL] %% alphabetical order
[# for code in doc.tags #]
\kwd{[-esc(code|trim)-]}
[# endfor #]
\end{keyword}
[# endif #]
[# endif #]
[# endif #]

\end{frontmatter}

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

%% template.yml. `preprint` does not change it, and supplements match the article
%% despite upstream naming ecta-fullname. docs/template-internals.md.
[# if doc.bibliography #]
\bibliographystyle{[# if options.journal == "ecta" #]econsoc[# elif options.journal == "te" #]te[# else #]qe[# endif #]} % Style BST file
\bibliography{[-doc.bibliography-]}  % Bibliography file (usually '*.bib')
[# else #]
%% NOTE: User has not specified a bibliography file in frontmatter.
%% If you want to use BibTeX, please specify 'bibliography: <your_bib_file.bib>'
